 10:45 PM ET 2 hours ago Trail Blazers and Lakers Look to Build on Their Strong Starts
 Portland began the season with two consecutive wins over the Phoenix Suns (124-83) and Sacramento Kings (128-120). Micah Nori's team has shown intensity and a variety of offensive options, with Donovan Clingan providing a strong presence in the paint and Deni Avdija adding versatility. The visitors will look to remain unbeaten and prove they can compete on the road.
 The Lakers, meanwhile, have won three straight games after defeating the Golden State Warriors (127-105), LA Clippers (125-117), and Utah Jazz (132-123). JJ Redick's team has started the campaign with a productive offense and strong collective performances. Playing in front of their home crowd, the Lakers will aim to extend their winning streak and secure their fourth victory of the season.

 10:36 PM ET 3 hours ago Players to Watch
 For the Los Angeles Lakers, Austin Reaves will be one of the players to watch. The shooting guard has made an impressive start to the season, averaging 26.7 points and 6.3 assists per game, while shooting 63.9% from the field and 61.5% from three-point range. His perimeter efficiency and playmaking ability will be important for the team coached by JJ Redick.
 For the Portland Trail Blazers, Deni Avdija will be one of the team's main offensive threats. The forward is averaging 22 points and eight rebounds per game, standing out for his ability to attack the basket, create second-chance opportunities, and take advantage of space in transition. His contribution will be crucial for Micah Nori's team to compete against the Lakers.
